deployment_source.note: GitHub Pages serves the docs-based site through the GitHub Actions deployment path

release_artifact.note: Qualifying main-branch changes build a ZIP plus SHA-256 manifest and preserve them as a 30-day GitHub Actions artifact

ipfs_mirror.note: Optional Storacha/IPFS mirror uses the current delegated-key workflow but is not enabled until STORACHA_PRINCIPAL and STORACHA_PROOF are configured; GitHub Pages remains canonical

home_page.note: Canonical public front door is available at the repository Pages root and now points people toward the World view first

world_page.note: Lightweight World page exposes dated global indicators, current participation paths, coordination boundaries, and evidence links without requiring an account

pwa_shell.note: Manifest, service worker, install helper banner, shared install wiring, and shared back-home app navigation are present; World is included in the offline shell

node_queue.note: Public light-node inbox and outbox feeds are exposed through the docs surface for bounded assignment visibility

node_claims.note: Append-only public claim feed shows when a light node has taken bounded ownership of an assignment before reporting the result

node_acks.note: Append-only public acknowledgement feed shows how a node closed its prior claim after reporting a bounded assignment outcome

registration_page.note: Registration status page loads publicly and distinguishes trusted-circle, limited-invitation, multi-steward capability, and still-closed global invitation stages

registration_checklist.note: Registration pilot readiness checklist loads publicly from the docs surface and matches the live Atlas and registration path

human_mesh_h0.note: Human Mesh H0 public architecture, declaration/accountability schemas, privacy boundaries, fictional fixtures, semantic guardrails, and CI validation are canonical

human_mesh_h1.note: Private lifecycle bridge is canonical and CI-tested for candidate creation, duplicate rejection, steward review, correction with fresh review, withdrawal, and self-authored withdrawal-event drafts; no automatic publication exists

human_mesh_h2_limited_invitation.note: The existing pilot server can optionally run in invite-gated H2 mode using expiring hashed invite codes, bounded requests, concurrency-safe record creation, and non-leaking participant storage; the mode is off by default and global open registration remains closed

human_mesh_h3_multi_steward.note: Private multi-steward review capability is implemented: decisions require an active rostered reviewer and retain steward-id provenance, while intake begins unassigned. Operational plurality is not claimed until at least two real human reviewers have explicitly accepted the role; synthetic CI reviewers do not count.

map_page.note: Map page and consent-based add-pin paths load publicly

contact_page.note: Simple public human contact and correction path loads publicly

compute_page.note: Compute page and metrics stub load publicly

atlas_page.note: Atlas route loads publicly and remains the canonical repository-orientation layer

coordination_stage_b.note: Synthetic consent-to-delivery breathing test is merged and validated in repo-health; no live allocation service is enabled

behavior_atlas_m2.note: First real project-level M2 evidence case is preserved outside the public Pages tree and remains validation-wired as a sourced historical artifact

behavior_atlas_m3.note: The original M3/M4A unlisted noindex previews remain preserved as guarded historical snapshots and continue to be protected from accidental public navigation links

behavior_atlas_m4_public_alpha.note: Three-case public alpha has a dedicated front door, source trails, single-reviewer warnings, correction paths, review-due stale warnings, changelog, expiry policy, privacy/harm review, release manifest, Project Atlas registration, and a CI restore drill to the recorded pre-alpha baseline; no scoring, Cooperation Index, or autonomous monitoring is enabled
